review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the CFGraph structure in ChipFiringWithLean/Basic.lean and related definitions (numEdges, graphConnected, genus). bridgeGraph is a construction on the library's own CFGraph, which is a loopless multigraph whose edges are a Multiset (V × V). I did not search Mathlib's Combinatorics/Graph directories. I know of no Mathlib counterpart for such a multigraph, so there is no matching Mathlib concept to compare against. Mathlib's SimpleGraph.sum and disjoint-union constructions apply to simple graphs and cannot represent parallel edges or the added bridge edge. The Sum vertex type uses Mathlib's Sum. The theorems are local API about this construction and are not a competing concept. Other files in the same repository define copies of CFGraph (Highlights.lean, TwiceMarkedBananas/CoreVocabulary.lean), but they are outside this file and not Mathlib concepts. I found no justified finding.
